note: Language coverage is reported SEPARATELY from country coverage and from UI locale support. 'ui_supported' only says the interface is translated; it establishes no occupation data. Levels: unsupported < targeted < source_identified < data_available < implemented < qualified. Nothing is qualified. 'resolver_level = implemented' means the resolver applies its deterministic normalization to the language and the behaviour is exercised on synthetic fixtures; it is NOT a claim of qualified alias data.
